g.text: An instructor wants to use two exams in her classes next year. This year,
she gives both exams to the students.
She wants to know if the exams are equally difficult and wants to check
this by looking at the differences between scores.
If the mean difference between scores for students is “close enough” to
zero, she will make a practical conclusion that the exams are equally
